title: Incomplete temporal sequence
question: Describe the person's transit across the floor. Does this clip establish their prior point of origin, ultimate destination, or motive?

observable_evidence_log.observation: Worker in orange vest is walking across warehouse floor at mid-ground
Maintains steady stride toward rear-right facility sector
Passes beyond intermediate floor partition area
Nears upper-right boundary of camera field of view
Body partially intersects right frame margin
Subject exits frame completely; sequence terminates with empty scene area

reviewer_A.technical_assessment: Temporal clipping: video starts mid-motion and cuts off immediately after exit. Temporal boundaries truncate antecedent and subsequent states.

reviewer_B.domain_rationale: A surveillance clip capturing an isolated snippet of transit cannot establish motive, prior events (e.g. unlawful entry elsewhere), or subsequent actions (e.g. departure from premises). A conclusion of wrongdoing requires end-to-end temporal continuity.
reviewer_B.evidentiary_status: Incomplete temporal record. Evidence does not establish events outside the recorded window.

adjudication.adjudication_notes: Consensus reached: transit and field-of-view exit are established; all antecedent, subsequent, and motivational claims are strictly unsupported.

provenance_disclosure: Modeled expert dual-reviewer protocol (CV Engineer & Loss Prevention Officer) developed for benchmark specification and rubric calibration; not biological crowd workers.
